text: {"567":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines the compiler's internal TokenStream type in its tokenstream module."},"568":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"rustc_expand implements the proc-macro token-stream conversion, while rustc_ast only defines the internal type."},"569":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The C-ABI choice describes the conversion implemented by rustc_expand's proc-macro machinery."},"570":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Custom derives are handled as a kind of procedural macro by macro expansion machinery."},"571":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The MBE system and its proposed hygiene, scoping, and visibility improvements belong to rustc_expand's declarative-macro implementation."}}
